reference_answer: This is common rust, a fungal disease causing small reddish-brown pustules on both sides of corn leaves. Organic management: plant rust-resistant maize hybrids; avoid dense planting to improve airflow; remove and destroy severely infected leaves; apply neem oil or sulfur spray as a preventive organic fungicide; rotate crops away from maize for at least one season if rust is recurring; ensure balanced potassium nutrition since rust is often worse in potassium-deficient plants.
